description: Changeset-based versioning workflow. Manually add .changeset/*.md files to describe changes instead of editing CHANGELOG.md directly. Changesets are consumed at publish time to bump versions and generate changelogs. ALWAYS load this skill when a repo has a .changeset/ folder. Before writing a changeset, read pending ones and update or remove overlapping entries so the next changelog describes the final user-facing behavior.
